opportunities.name: Catalog Preflight: local Shopify CSV checks
opportunities.audience: Freelance store migration specialists reviewing client product catalogs
opportunities.problem: Quoting, uneven rows and repeated variant options can derail a catalog import.
opportunities.product: A browser-only CSV preflight with row-number diagnostics, legacy/current header aliases and a report that omits cell values.
opportunities.distribution_test: After publishing permission and cost safeguards, release one original troubleshooting guide with a free sample; make no bulk outreach. Measure opt-in usefulness feedback before any paid offer.
opportunities.counterargument: Shopify and Matrixify already diagnose imports. Offline checking has no demonstrated commercial advantage and cannot see API or existing-store errors.
opportunities.assumption: Agencies might value a private row-only report before connecting a store; no interviews, visitors or willingness to pay have been observed.

opportunities.name: WooCommerce catalog batch diagnostics
opportunities.problem: Inconsistent column mapping, duplicate identifiers and large CSV batches can create skipped imports.
opportunities.product: An offline checklist and row report for a documented subset of product CSV rules.
opportunities.distribution_test: Publish a factual schema guide only after infrastructure permission; seek opt-in agency feedback.
opportunities.counterargument: WooCommerce already includes CSV import and error reporting at no separate charge.
opportunities.assumption: A pre-import local report would need to save enough agency time to justify buying; this is untested.

opportunities.name: BigCommerce import error locator
opportunities.audience: Catalog managers preparing a product migration
opportunities.problem: Identifiers, row ordering and numeric formats can cause partial catalog imports.
opportunities.product: An offline diagnostic report mapping a limited set of CSV faults to row numbers.
opportunities.distribution_test: Evaluate an original guide for one specific documented error, with opt-in feedback only.
opportunities.counterargument: The built-in error report and platform support already cover these failures; full schema maintenance adds servicing cost.
opportunities.assumption: Migration urgency may make a one-off tool attractive, but accessible distribution and payment demand are unverified.

opportunities.name: Merchant Center TSV structure report
opportunities.audience: Small merchants preparing a data source
opportunities.problem: Missing required attributes, inconsistent tabs and encodings can prevent feed processing.
opportunities.product: A local TSV structure checker limited to mechanical file defects.
opportunities.distribution_test: Write an original worked sample; ask for voluntary usefulness feedback after approved publication.
opportunities.counterargument: Google supplies free processing diagnostics. Product disapprovals and policy outcomes cannot be inferred from a file-only checker.
opportunities.assumption: Earlier structure feedback could save iteration time, but nobody has demonstrated willingness to pay.

opportunities.name: Shopify variant collision report
opportunities.problem: Two rows can encode the same product option combination and trigger an import failure.
opportunities.product: A local handle-plus-options collision report respecting image-only continuation rows.
opportunities.distribution_test: Evaluate a guide on duplicate options after approved publication; no unsolicited contacts.
opportunities.counterargument: This is a feature of the wider catalog checker and existing importers, with weak standalone defensibility.
opportunities.assumption: A supplier-heavy merchant might prefer a separate preflight; problem frequency is unknown.

opportunities.name: Catalog numeric field preflight
opportunities.problem: Currency symbols or locale separators in numeric fields can break catalog imports.
opportunities.product: A non-editing report showing rows with nonconforming price strings.
opportunities.distribution_test: A public worked example only after publication permission; measure voluntary completion feedback.
opportunities.counterargument: Generic spreadsheet validation is free, and automatically changing numeric meaning would be unsafe.
opportunities.assumption: A small local validator may prevent avoidable mistakes; purchase intent is not established.

opportunities.name: CSV encoding and BOM preflight
opportunities.audience: Store assistants exchanging catalogs with Excel
opportunities.problem: Different encodings and byte-order marks can garble text or confuse downstream importers.
opportunities.product: A local encoding detector and non-destructive guidance limited to supported encodings.
opportunities.distribution_test: Publish a tested synthetic example and collect opt-in feedback if infrastructure is cleared.
opportunities.counterargument: Editors and existing import tools already support UTF-8 and BOM settings; automatic encoding guesses can corrupt text.
opportunities.assumption: A clearer explanation may help occasional users, but free substitutes likely constrain pricing.

opportunities.name: RSS feed structural diagnosis
opportunities.problem: Malformed feed XML can interrupt syndication.
opportunities.product: A bounded local parser that reports mechanical XML errors without fetching user-provided URLs.
opportunities.distribution_test: Research public feed failure questions; publish original samples after approval, without scraping prohibited sources.
opportunities.counterargument: A vendor offer alone does not prove demand; free validators and editor tools compete strongly.
opportunities.assumption: Time-sensitive syndication failures could support a one-off purchase, but failure incidence is unmeasured.

opportunities.name: Calendar migration structure check
opportunities.problem: Malformed calendar files can prevent event imports.
opportunities.product: An offline structural checker that never shifts times or changes recurrence automatically.
opportunities.distribution_test: Inspect voluntary user problem reports and publish a synthetic example only with permitted hosting.
opportunities.counterargument: Competitor pricing is not proof of payment; time zones and recurrence create high support and correctness burdens.
opportunities.assumption: Users might pay to avoid a failed import, but important events increase harm from incorrect repairs.

opportunities.name: Catalog image reference manifest
opportunities.audience: Store migration contractors reviewing product images
opportunities.problem: Missing or inaccessible image references can cause partial imports.
opportunities.product: A local manifest of missing image fields and malformed HTTPS URL strings; no remote crawling.
opportunities.distribution_test: Test a sample diagnostic article after approved publication; seek voluntary contractor feedback.
opportunities.counterargument: Local URL syntax cannot prove image accessibility, licensing, matching or successful import; remote checking introduces SSRF and bandwidth concerns.
opportunities.assumption: Contractors might value a checklist, but the narrow output may be insufficient to charge for.
